title: A worker whose gate the class rule makes blocking goes on with the recommendation and the landing waits for the operator's answer
goal: When gate add makes a worker's open choice blocking by its class (push, agents-rule) and the worker's recommendation is implementable, the worker finishes the work on the recommendation and land refuses until the operator answers, instead of the worker stopping; in SP-dqkf3i42 workers stopped or recorded blocking gates on seven tasks (TK-uwu2lgvo twice, TK-g4c5kxsc, TK-7k2p3vif, TK-mialzcmq, TK-d556hzob, TK-mzssxnf6, TK-3zfpmq4u, TK-g67asvm5) and three needed a resumed session only to carry out a plan the orchestrator then approved unchanged
notes: SP-ciqk6gt6 close: five gates were made blocking by the class rule after the work (TK-p7ajxp72 g2, TK-7nnd2bdm g1, TK-cagohpbu g2, TK-j5rcgylo g1, BG-rqxspwtb g3); each worker stopped, and the orchestrator answered each with its recommendation and landed. Recurred at SP-x5gjv4r7 (2026-10-10): the class rule made blocking gates of ST-xuhig3u6 g4 to g6, ST-ylje2dxh g3 and ST-ifljijni g3, each recorded with the recommendation the code already implemented; ST-ifljijni stopped before its docs and needed a resumed session after the operator's answer. Recurrence SP-7n3d4jte (2026-10-12): the ST-b27c527d worker recorded four design gates (rrf-tie, ledger-hit, routed-size, eval-guard) that the agents-rule class made blocking and stopped before any code; the orchestrator answered them with the recommendations and resumed it, a second session of 107 turns. Later workers of the sprint were given the operator's standing delegation in a --probe and did not stop. Merged from ST-fmjx3psu “A worker records as a gate a narrowing of the rows its goal names before it reports, not after the orchestrator asks” at the 2026-10-12 draft triage: Same failure as ST-6vtjmoyr: a worker omits or under-records a gate for a choice it called no new choice and is sent back to record it. One worker rule on which choices are recorded as provisional gates before the report covers both; the check test is not written yet. Its goal: A sprint worker whose change judges fewer rows than its goal names (BG-fl4sg2py: the unstated-names warning covers only lookup_eval-sourced rows, though the goal says each eval and near-miss row, narrowed so a fixture test passes) records that choice as a provisional gate before its report; at SP-j2jn5ue4 the worker called it no new choice and the orchestrator had to resume the session to record g2. Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/tests.py", "-k", "brief_names_goal_narrowing_gate"]}
